mission_02: Mode and constant value imputation extend simple imputation strategies to handle categorical data and special use cases. Mode imputation (most_frequent strategy) replaces missing categorical values with the most common category, analogous to mean imputation for numeric data. Constant value imputation fills all missing entries with a user-specified value, which is particularly useful for creating explicit missing indicators or when domain knowledge suggests a specific default value. For example, filling missing 'number_of_children' with 0 or missing 'is_premium_member' with False. The SimpleImputer class handles both numeric and categorical columns uniformly, making it a versatile tool for any dataset with missing values.
